     2	 * Bidirectional validation: task.json vs source code

     9	import ts from 'typescript';
    10	import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'fs';
    11	import { join } from 'path';

    14	interface ValidationResult {
    15	  orphanRecords: Array<{ key: string; reason: string }>;
    16	  missingRecords: Array<{ file: string; functionName: string; line: number }>;
    17	  signatureMismatch: Array<{ key: string; stored: string; actual: string }>;
    18	  healthy: boolean;

    20	
    21	function findAllFunctions(filePath: string): Array<{ name: string; line: number; signature: string }> {
    22	  if (!existsSync(filePath)) return [];
    23	  const code = readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');
    24	  const source = ts.createSourceFile(filePath, code, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true);
    25	  const results: Array<{ name: string; line: number; signature: string }> = [];
    26	
    27	  function visit(node: ts.Node) {
    28	    if (ts.isFunctionDeclaration(node) && node.name) {
    29	      const line = source.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(node.getStart()).line + 1;
    30	      results.push({ name: node.name.text, line,
    31	        signature: code.slice(node.getStart(), code.indexOf('{', node.getStart())).trim().slice(0, 120) });
    32	    }
    33	    if (ts.isConstructorDeclaration(node)) {
    34	      const line = source.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(node.getStart()).line + 1;
    35	      results.push({ name: 'constructor', line, signature: 'constructor()' });
    36	    }
    37	    if (ts.isMethodDeclaration(node) && node.name) {
    38	      const name = ts.isIdentifier(node.name) ? node.name.text : node.name.getText(source);
    39	      const line = source.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(node.getStart()).line + 1;
    40	      results.push({ name, line,
    41	        signature: code.slice(node.getStart(), code.indexOf('{', node.getStart())).trim().slice(0, 120) });
    42	    }
    43	    if (ts.isClassDeclaration(node) && node.name) {
    44	      const line = source.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(node.getStart()).line + 1;
    45	      results.push({ name: node.name.text, line, signature: `class ${node.name.text}` });
    46	    }
    47	    if (ts.isVariableStatement(node)) {
    48	      for (const decl of node.declarationList.declarations) {
    49	        if (ts.isIdentifier(decl.name) && decl.initializer &&
    50	            (ts.isArrowFunction(decl.initializer) || ts.isFunctionExpression(decl.initializer))) {
    51	          const line = source.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(node.getStart()).line + 1;
    52	          results.push({ name: decl.name.text, line,
    53	            signature: code.slice(node.getStart(), code.indexOf('=>', node.getStart()) + 2).trim().slice(0, 120) });
    54	        }
    55	      }
    56	    }
    57	    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
    58	  }
    59	  ts.forEachChild(source, visit);
    60	  return results;
    61	}
    62	
    63	export function validateMetadata(tasks: TaskRecord[], scanRoot: string): ValidationResult {
    64	  const orphanRecords: ValidationResult['orphanRecords'] = [];
    65	  const missingRecords: ValidationResult['missingRecords'] = [];
    66	  const signatureMismatch: ValidationResult['signatureMismatch'] = [];
    67	
    68	  // Group tasks by file
    69	  const tasksByFile = new Map<string, TaskRecord[]>();
    70	  for (const t of tasks) {
    71	    const file = t.sourceFile;
    72	    if (!tasksByFile.has(file)) tasksByFile.set(file, []);
    73	    tasksByFile.get(file)!.push(t);
    74	  }
    75	
    76	  // Check each file
    77	  const checkedFiles = new Set<string>();
    78	  for (const [file, fileTasks] of tasksByFile) {
    79	    checkedFiles.add(file);
    80	    const filePath = join(scanRoot, file);
    81	
    82	    if (!existsSync(filePath)) {
    83	      for (const t of fileTasks) {
    84	        orphanRecords.push({ key: t.key, reason: `File deleted: ${file}` });
    85	      }
    86	      continue;
    87	    }
    88	
    89	    const functions = findAllFunctions(filePath);
    90	
    91	    for (const t of fileTasks) {
    92	      if (!t.functionName) continue; // file-level record, skip
    93	      const fn = functions.find(f => f.name === t.functionName);
    94	      if (!fn) {
    95	        orphanRecords.push({ key: t.key, reason: `Function deleted: ${t.functionName} in ${file}` });
    96	      }
    97	    }
    98	  }
    99	
   100	  return {
   101	    orphanRecords,
   102	    missingRecords,
   103	    signatureMismatch,
   104	    healthy: orphanRecords.length === 0 && missingRecords.length === 0 && signatureMismatch.length === 0,
   105	  };
   106	}
